authorization.quote: 现在还是在门禁层进行简化优化，就目前的阻碍点在于，在实际情况下，在我做q3时有一个新点子需要传播回q1q2，但这个过程中耗时最长的不是新点子的实现，而是各类门禁的回填，就很麻烦

observed_failure.change: Q3 geometry-window pruning backported to Q1 and Q2 with the mathematical contract unchanged
observed_failure.finding: The controller lacked a compatible implementation change class and sealed only one state_effect per execution, so an implementation-equivalent cross-question change was forced through serial model-redesign lifecycle replay.

decision: Keep ordinary propagation in one G1 cross-component ChangeSet with no lifecycle mutation or persistent evidence backfill.
Represent acceptance as a validity overlay, not a new lifecycle state or a synthetic S7-to-S2 redesign.
Seal all affected questions and exact post-specification evidence levels in one G2 compatible-change execution.
Install replacement evidence and declared identity refreshes through one atomic bundle; reject missing evidence or undeclared exact consumers without a partial state commit.
Reuse current scope, problem definition, evidence plan, candidate set, model specification, and selection rationale only after their live evidence identities are revalidated.

Close the identity world by requiring every actual protected registered delta in artifact_updates, globally scanning changed file/command locators and artifact input refs, binding fresh replacement locators to the ChangeSet, and using optional claim_updates only for actual claim identity deltas bound to old/new producer claim-text SHA-256 identities and exact typed consumers.
Do not block the batch for an unrelated unprotected working artifact that has no exact evidence binding.
Seal target and source state, status, and invalidation markers so reconciliation cannot erase an intervening validity change.

For compatible-change R1, read unchanged official inputs by identity and semantically reread target model/selection sources, the source question implementation and E1/E2 evidence, plus actual workspace deltas.
Escalate to the ordinary earliest-layer reopen whenever the model contract, selection, assumptions, objective, constraints, feasible domain, or claim boundary changes.
preserved: All V15 active atoms, capability packets, transition edges, artifact controls, recovery barriers, dangerous-runtime authorization, and Skill-maintenance isolation remain active.
E1 and E2 remain mandatory for each implementation target; E3, E4, uncertainty, and robustness are refreshed whenever the declared delta actually affects them.
An exact consumer outside the declared closure remains fail-closed.
Normal model redesign and failed-evidence reopen paths remain unchanged.
Freeze, installation, and stable-version replacement still require separate explicit authorization.
